Still two definitions of 'locked': the 'on the card' counter uses `new Set([...include, ...locked]).size` where `locked` is card.tools.locked only (AgentCardPanels.tsx:85, :126), while each row computes `isLocked = Boolean(t.locked) || locked.has(t.key)` and `on = includeSet.has(t.key) || isLocked` (:154-155), i.e. catalog-level locks count as on. The counter and the row states diverge as soon as a catalog tool is locked (t.locked) but not listed in card.tools.locked. Consistent today only by data coincidence; MINOR.
